final: WITH oc AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), sh AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, CAST(num_orders AS REAL) / SUM(num_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS share FROM oc), av AS (SELECT sh.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, share, share - avg_share AS gap FROM av WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
